SlackChannelRelatedRecord.name: SlackChannelRelatedRecord
SlackChannelRelatedRecord.description: Represents the related record mapping between a Slack channel and a Salesforce record that’s made when you create a Salesforce channel.

Name.description: The name of the related record mapping.

RelatedRecord.description: The Salesforce record ID associated with the related record mapping.

SlackChannel.description: The Slack channel ID of the Salesforce channel associated with the related record mapping.

TopLevelTeam.description: The Slack Enterprise org ID associated with the Salesforce channel.
